LESSON: INTEGERS SIMPLE AND COMBINED OPERATIONS ON INTEGERS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.1: Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform basic operations on Integers in different situations
2. apply Integers to real- life situations
3. appreciate the use of integers in real-life situations

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INTEGERS SIMPLE AND COMBINED OPERATIONS ON INTEGERS
Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Integers Simple and combined operations on Integers in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. perform basic operations on Integers in different situations
2. apply Integers to real- life situations
3. appreciate the use of integers in real-life situations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
